_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
April 14th, 2:24 PM
Good afternoon riders and skiers!  Spring conditions greet us once again like an ephemeral crocus in bloom. We are seeing partly sunny skies, and temps on the rise into the upper 50's at the summit and low 60's at the base. There is an increasing chance of rain showers as the afternoon moves along, so saddle up your moisture wicking gear and carpe these days while we've still got the snow to dance on. Expect soft spring conditions around the mountain, before rain arrives and delivers wet granular surfaces. With temps staying above freezing tonight, our grooming team will be limited to 2nd shift grooming. Ungroomed terrain will feature a slightly firm crust covering soft snow. Please read posted signage before entering trails, as difficulties have changed due to conditions and thin coverage in spots. 

We’ll be getting down on 119 skiable acres with 2 scheduled lifts and 11 of 21 trails groomed. Operations have moved to weekday Spring hours, with Valley House spinning from 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM and Heaven's Gate spinning 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM. Valley House will be operating in place of Super Bravo for the remainder of the season in order to preserve snow. 

How many consecutive days are you at? Did you know that if you ski consecutive days on your Ikon pass this spring season you are eligible for sweet prizes?  If you’re already looking ahead to next winter, you’re in luck: season passes for next season are officially on sale. Now’s the perfect time to lock in the best deals and start dreaming about another year on the mountain. Check out all the sweet pass options and perks, we’ve got something for every type of rider.

Both of the Lincoln Peak uphill travel routes are currently CLOSED. The Mt. Ellen uphill route is now CLOSED as well. Please review our Uphill Travel Policy for full details.
